d.ko: Survival horror MMO. As one of the few survivors of the outbreak, you must scratch a living out of the decaying ruins of society. Scavenge for supplies, improve your skills, and trade with other players. All the while, keeping your eyes peeled for the infected lurking around every corner.

d.zh: 最黑暗的网上恐怖游戏。身为爆发的其中一位幸存者，你必须在没落的社会的废墟中求生。拾荒寻找资源，提升自身的技能，与其他玩家交易，可别忘了注意在各个角落后埋伏着的丧尸
